dedupe_keys.name: iru transpark truck parking areas fuel stations and customs offices with security and comfort levels

description: TRANSPark is a web application of IRU, the International Road Transport Union, for searching truck parking areas; its footer credits IRU and the International Transport Forum (ITF). Coverage: parking areas in the 79 countries listed in the country selector, from Europe and Central Asia to the Middle East, parts of Africa, China, India, Mexico, Canada and the United States, with map layers for parking areas, fuel stations and customs authorities. Each parking area carries a certification state (uncertified, self-assessed, self-assessed certified or certified), security and comfort levels from 1 to 5, and facilities such as 24-hour service, guard, fences, video, flood lighting, fuel station, electric connection, acceptance of dangerous goods, restaurant, hotel, sanitaries, vehicle wash, repair and medical service. Parking owners register to edit their areas and self-assess security and comfort. Format and access: an interactive search by country, address and radius (10 to 200 km), with an advanced facility filter and a route planner, in English, French, Russian and Turkish; free to search. No bulk download or API was seen. Licence: all rights reserved (IRU/ITF copyright notice). Caveats: entries are maintained by parking owners and self-assessment is common, so completeness and currency vary; the number of parking areas was not read. Simulation uses: locations and security levels of truck stops along freight corridors, for freight network, rest-stop capacity and cargo security studies, and for rerouting heavy goods vehicles during disruptions. Related records: no closely related open truck parking inventory was found in the catalogue during this check.
